title: Lance-Bearer's First Workbook
summary: A first workbook for untrained hands on hefting, carrying and thrusting a heavy lance on foot.

title: Handbook of the Heavy Spear
summary: Teaches new students a wide stance and the short jab, long lunge and guards of the heavy lance.

title: The Footman's Lance Drill-Book
summary: A drill text for marching foot soldiers carrying the lance, covering the march, the ready drop and the close thrust.

title: Short Lessons on Carrying the Lance
summary: Short lessons on carrying the lance slung and bringing it to bear quickly from the strap.

title: Lance Against the Charge: A Plain Treatise
summary: Shows foot soldiers how to plant the lance against a mounted charge and hold the line of points.

title: Rider's Primer on the Couched Lance
summary: A primer for new riders on seat, rest, couching and the first mounted thrust.

title: Saddle and Shaft Beginner's Canon
summary: A beginner's canon pairing the rider's seat with the shaft, from standing rise to the gallop strike.

title: The Tilt-Yard Training Book
summary: The practice book of the tilt-yard lane, teaching an even pace, a true strike and the return.

title: Ring-and-Post Exercise Handbook
summary: A handbook of ring-taking, post-striking and quintain exercises that train a rider's aim at speed.

title: Lance and Rein Workbook
summary: A workbook on working lance and reins together, including one-handed strokes and steering by the neck.
